The '''First Sith Imperial Strikeforce''' was a unit within the [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Navy]] formed both by members of the [[One Sith]] and Navy officers, particularly [[1st Imperial Center Core Defense Squadron|Skull Squadron]]. It was commanded by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Rulf Yage]] and his fellow [[Moff/Legends|Moff]], the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Fehlaaur'aitel'loro]]. In [[137 ABY]] the strikeforce was sent by [[Regent/Legends|Regent]] [[Morlish Veed]] to complete [[Operation: Thunderstroke]], a mission to capture [[Empire-in-exile|Emperor-in-exile]] [[Roan Fel]] at [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. The topmost [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] within the strikeforce was [[Darth Rauder]], whom oversaw all pilots, both Sith and non-Sith.

During the ensuing battle, the strikeforce's flagship, ''[[War Hammer]]'', destroyed the Fel-loyalist Star Destroyer [[Dauntless (Pellaeon-class)|''Dauntless'']], under the command of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Tohri Challon]], but failed to stop Roan Fel from escaping in his [[Defender One|shuttle]].
